name: Rough Trade East
address: Old Truman Brewery, 91 Brick Lane, London
summary: Rough Trade's flagship UK record shop, inside the Old Truman Brewery complex off Brick Lane. The 5,000 sq ft store sells vinyl, books and merchandise, has a photobooth and a bar, and puts on in-store gigs on its own stage.

music.notes: In-store live events every day of the week on a purpose-built stage. Sets are shorter than at a normal gig, and well-known acts can draw long queues.

accessibility.notes: Ramped, wheelchair-friendly entrance and a shop floor all on one level. Accessible parking bays are on site, within 50 metres of the entrance, and the Old Truman Brewery has public car parks.

cost.notes: Time Out says in-store gigs are usually free but must be booked through DICE, or are free when you buy the performer's new album.

evidence.quote: Located in Old Truman Brewery, just off Brick Lane, this is our flagship UK store. The 5000 square feet space boasts a large vinyl selection, a complimentary selection of books and merchandise as well as our legendary Photobooth and Bar.
The store hosts live events 7 days a week
Old Truman Brewery 91, Brick Ln, London E1 6QL
it also welcomes live performers of pretty much every persuasion to their purpose-built stage
Gigs are more often than not free (although tickets need to be booked via Dice), or free with purchase of the new album by whoever's playing.
Sets are shorter than a regular gig and there can be long queues for bigger named acts
The shop has a wheelchair accessible entrance ramp, and is laid out on a single level without the need for stairs.
On-site accessible parking bays are available within 50 metres of the entrance.
The Old Truman Brewery has three public car parks.
A designated accessible toilet designed for wheelchair users and others with visible and non-visible accessibility requirements is available within the main public areas.
